parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the refrigerator, made of steel with an insulated core.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator compartment and seals tightly to maintain internal temperature.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the refrigerator, made of steel with an insulated core.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer or secondary compartment and seals to preserve temperature.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close.
